displayName: OCI-AI-HAL-002: AI — Hallucination — Inconsistent Factual Claims
description:
Detects LLM outputs making contradictory factual claims across conversation turns

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_hal_002", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%hallucination%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%inconsistent%') AND "value" > 0
